hook.text: A gas engine has hundreds of moving parts. An electric motor has about 20. Fewer parts mean fewer jobs.

buildup.text: Transmission plants, exhaust system factories, and engine foundries face shutdown as EVs scale.

discovery.text: New jobs emerge in battery manufacturing, charging infrastructure, and software development.

twist.text: But the new jobs aren't always in the same places or for the same workers as the old ones.

climax.text: Governments are racing to retrain workers and attract battery factories to displaced communities.

punchline.text: EVs create jobs—just not for everyone who loses one.

quiz.question: Why do EVs require fewer manufacturing workers?
options: They have far fewer moving parts
